'''Block 135''' was a cityblock in the [[Kesk Cityblock]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]].<ref name="Raid" /> By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="FarOrbitDate">{{FarOrbitDate}}</ref> it was a small commercial shopping district that supplied the wants and needs of the local populace. Like the rest of Kesk Cityblock, it was serviced by a large mass transit system. The [[Jovvitz]], an abandoned nightclub located in Block 135, was the site where [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]] from the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] ''[[Far Orbit]]'' [[Mission to Brentaal IV|met]] with an Alliance [[Unidentified Rebel waiter|contact]] to retrieve a sensitive [[Datacard/Legends|datadisc]], and where [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Security Bureau]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]] tracked the privateers to before attacking them.<ref name="Raid" />

==Behind the scenes==
Block 135 appeared in ''[[Raid on Brentaal]]'', an adventure scenario in [[1998]]'s ''[[The Far Orbit Project]]'', by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]]. The book was a supplement to [[West End Games]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and had the same theme of the previous publication ''[[Pirates & Privateers]]'', as it followed the privateering frigate ''Far Orbit'' in its adventures.<ref name="Raid" />
